note: Gallbladder cancer, mass on imaging (PDF page 10): the page was empty because three pages shared the code GALL-4 (see GALL-3.json). Workup, resectable (resection, adjuvant treatment GALL-6) or unresectable (biopsy and biomarker testing, systemic therapy options, best supportive care). The entry 'Mass on imaging' has no condition (presentation_type has no value for it; 'symptomatic' is for pain/jaundice/obstruction) and is typed other so that it does not inherit the relapse condition of the GALL-6 boxes that link here.

footnotes.f: Core biopsy is preferred over FNA.
footnotes.g: For patients with dMMR/MSI-H tumors or a family history suggestive of BRCA1/2 PVs, consider germline testing and/or referral to a genetic counselor.
footnotes.i: Order does not indicate preference. The choice of treatment modality may depend on extent/location of disease and institutional capabilities.
footnotes.m: For locoregionally advanced disease, consider neoadjuvant systemic therapy to rule out rapid progression and avoid futile surgery. There are limited clinical trial data to define a standard regimen or definitive benefit. See Principles of Systemic Therapy (BIL-C).
footnotes.p: CEA and CA 19-9 are baseline tests and should not be done to confirm diagnosis.
